_comment: Advisories the dependency audit gate (scripts/check-audit.mjs) will not fail on.
Only high/critical advisories are ever blocking, so only those need entries here.
id:      GitHub advisory id, e.g. GHSA-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx (as reported by `pnpm audit --json`)
package: the vulnerable package, for humans reading the diff
reason:  why this does not apply to us, or why it cannot be fixed yet.
'we should fix this later' is not a reason — say what makes it non-exploitable here.
expires: YYYY-MM-DD it stops being accepted. Past this date the gate fails again
so an accepted risk gets re-argued instead of inherited forever.
Prefer raising the floor in `pnpm.overrides` (root package.json) over adding an entry.
